about: Private security advisories Hey Research Lab filed on GitHub. Counts per project and state only: no finding, file or severity of an unpublished advisory is ever kept here, and a project is named only when it is already public in HALL_OF_FAME.md. Kept by hand. publishedReadFrom lists the public repositories whose published advisories crediting hey-research-lab are read live from GitHub's API (github.com/hey-research-lab's profile draws them).
